legend-ormond-scenic-loop-and-trail.slogan: Ormond Scenic Loop and Trail – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-ormond-scenic-loop-and-trail.story: Florida Scenic Highway. live oaks, marsh, Atlantic coast. From Ormond Beach it runs 29 km to Ormond Beach; allow about 32 min of riding. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Florida A1A Scenic and Historic Coastal Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Florida A1A Scenic and Historic Coastal Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
